en: Arf arf!
cz: Haf haf!

en: Awoooo!
cz: Auuuuu!

en: Everyone here is so nice.
cz: Vsichni tady jsou tak mili.

en:
I hear you've got a good chance of
turning up some rare {Color:Red}figurines{Color:White}...
If you hand over lots of {Color:Red}Mysterious
Shells{Color:White} in one big load, that is...
Hehehe...
cz:
Slysel jsem, ze mas slusnou sanci
ziskat vzacne {Color:Red}figurky{Color:White}...
Kdyz odevzdas spoustu {Color:Red}Tajemnych
Ulit{Color:White} v jedne velke davce, samozrejme...
Hehehe...

en:
!?

The {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}!

Man. That sounded impressive. If I find
it, I'm gonna shout that so loudly!
cz:
!?

{Color:Red}Svetelna sila{Color:White}!

Ty jo. To znelo uchvatne. Az to najdu,
budu to rvat na celej les!

en:
Kids are so innocent and simple.
Well, until they grow up, anyway...
cz:
Deti jsou tak nevinne a proste.
No, dokud nevyrostou...

en:
I'm a rich guy, see?
And I'm a collector to boot.
cz:
Jsem bohac, vis?
A k tomu jeste sberatel.

en:
If you ever find a complete set of
{Color:Green}figurines{Color:White}, you should tell me.
You...do know what I'm talking about,
don't you? Well? Get to it!
cz:
Az nasbiras kompletni sadu
{Color:Green}figurek{Color:White}, dej mi vedet.
Ty...vis o cem mluvim,
ze jo? No? Tak hybej!

en:
!?

Whooooooooooooaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!

You did it! I can't believe you did it!
This is...a totally complete set!
How incredibly awesome! And you even
got the legendary Carlov Medal!!! 
It shines with a beautiful light...
It's every collector's dream!
What you've shown me here... It's
just... It's just amazing.
Here, feel free to go in my house and
take whatever you want in thanks...
'Cuz, you know, I'm rich! Hahaha!
cz:
!?

Jupiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii!!!!

Dokazals to! Nemuzu uverit, ze jsi to
dokazal! Tohle je...uplne kompletni sada!
Neuveritelne uzasne! A jeste jsi ziskal
legendarni Carlovovu medaili!!! 
Zari nadhernym svetlem...
To je sen kazdeho sberatele!
Co jsi mi tu ukazal... To je
proste... Proste uzasne.
Klidne si dojdi k nam domu a vezmi si
cokoliv chces jako podekovani...
Protoze, vis, jsem bohac! Hahaha!

en:
Way to go, man.
What an awesome day...
cz:
Tak to je super, kamo.
Jaky uzasny den...

en: My food is coming up, I think...
cz: Jidlo mi prinasi, mam pocit...

en: Yaaay! Yaaay!
cz: Jupiii! Jupiii!

en:
I have to tend the flower beds
out back, too.
cz:
Musim se postarat i o zahonky
vzadu na zahrade.

en:
Huh?

This flower bed looks a
little strange.
cz:
Co?

Tenhle zahonek vypada
trochu divne.

en:
Oh! You found me. You must be
quite an attentive young man!
Well, now you've got something to
brag about to your friends.
I feel I should give you something to
reward your abilities of perception!
Call it a "Master of Sur-Prize"!
Good job!
cz:
Oh! Tys me nasel. To musis byt
opravdu vsimavy mladenec!
Takze ted mas o cem chvastat
pred kamaradama.
Mam pocit, ze bych ti mel dat neco
za odmenu za tvuj postreh!
Nazveme to "Cena za Pre-Kvap"!
Dobra prace!

en:
I have to say, good job on meeting me!

Seriously, you'll be able to brag about
this to your friends forever!
cz:
Musim rict, ze setkani se mnou si zaslouzi
pochvalu!

Vazne, tim se budes moct chlubit
kamaradum navzdy!

en:
Once you start collecting figurines,
there's no end to it!
As soon as new limited-edition specials
come out, my eyes glass over, man.
cz:
Kdyz zacnes sbirat figurky,
uz to nikdy neskonci!
Jakmile vyjdou nove limitovane edice,
oci se mi rozzari, kamo.

en:
We tend to stay inside a lot. Don't want
to get trampled, you know?
Not that being stepped on would kill
us, but it doesn't sound fun, does it?
cz:
Radsi zustavame vevnitr. Nechceme
byt zaslapnuti, vis?
Ne ze by nas to zabilo, ale
zas tak zabavne to neni, ze ne?

en:
What's a ghost? Is that like a guest
who's overstayed his welcome?
cz:
Co je to duch? Je to jako host,
ktery se zdrzel prilis dlouho?

en:
You come here a lot... I guess you
must like this place.
cz:
Chodis sem casto... Asi se ti
tohle misto opravdu libi.

en:
Yellow is a rare color for us Minish.
There's a good side and a bad side to
being rare, though.
Two yellow ones rarely ever show up in
the same place, so they never meet up!
cz:
Zluta je u nas Minish vzacna barva.
Byt vzacny ma vsak svetlou
i stinnou stranku.
Dva zluti se zridka objevi na stejnem
miste, takze se nikdy nepotkaji!

en:
Thanks for coming.

Hardly anyone ever visits, and it gets
lonely here. Please take this.
cz:
Diky, ze jsi prisel.

Skoro nikdo sem nechodi a je tu
smutno. Vezmi si tohle, prosim.

en:
The view from here is nice.

And Swiftblade's screams during
training seem to complement the scene.
cz:
Vyhled odsud je pekny.

A Swiftbladeovo vykrikovani pri
treninku scene dodava ten spravny pel.

en:
Good job getting up here.
Really. That's impressive.
You must have really put yourself out
to find a way here. Please take this.
cz:
Dobra prace, ze ses sem dostal.
Vazne. To je obdivuhodne.
Musels se opravdu snazit, abys nasel
cestu sem. Vezmi si tohle, prosim.

en:
I wonder how I'm going to get down...
Those cucco chicks just terrify me.
cz:
Jak se asi dostanu dolu...
Ta cucca kuratka me desi.

en:
Lately, Mutoh's been grumbling about
how there's no work with any punch.
I wish I could do something about that,
but I don't even know what he means!
cz:
V poslednim case Mutoh remca,
ze neni zadna prace s sumem.
Rad bych s tim neco udelal,
ale nevim ani, co tim mysli!

en:
I'm so glad the boss is back to his
usual self.
It just makes you grateful
for the good times, you know?
cz:
Jsem rad, ze je sef zase
ve sve kuzi.
Clovek je pak vdecnejsi
za ty dobre casy, vis?

en:
There are so few people here now. I'm
afraid something terrible will happen.
cz:
Je tu ted tak malo lidi. Bojim se,
ze se stane neco hrozneho.

en: Meoooow...
cz: Mnauuuu...

en: Rowrrr!
cz: Vrrrr!

en:
Buggedy-buggedy-BOO!

Don't worry. I'm already looking
for another job.
cz:
Strasidlo-strasidlo-BU!

Neboj. Uz si hledam
jinou praci.

en: Now, it's time for our rematch!
cz: Tak, ted je cas na odvetu!

en: Arf arf!
cz: Haf haf!

en:
Fewer people means less trash... I'm
having a tough time finding food...
cz:
Min lidi znamena min odpadu...
Mam problem najit zradlo...

en:
{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle {Color:White}looks so strange now.
There are monsters everywhere...
Even the town's not safe anymore.
The people all stay locked up indoors.
cz:
{Color:Green}Hrad Hyrule {Color:White}ted vypada tak divne.
Vsude jsou monstra...
Uz ani mesto neni v bezpeci.
Lidi se zavreli doma.

en:
Hey, hey! It's a closeout sale!
Everything must go!
cz:
Hej, hej! Vyprodej!
Vse musi pryc!

en:
Clearance prices, people! What are
you waiting for!? Hey, hey!
cz:
Vyprodejni ceny, lidi! Na co
cekate!? Hej, hej!

en:
Hey, hey! My mom'll be mad if I take all
this stuff home, so shop up!
cz:
Hej, hej! Mamka se bude zlobit,
kdyz si to vsechno odnesu domu, tak nakupujte!

en:
Anyone want to trade for fruit!?
Anybody? Hello? Hey, hey!
cz:
Nikdo nechce smenit ovoce!?
Nikdo? Halo? Hej, hej!

en:
I can't believe this. {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}
has been overrun with monsters...
cz:
Nemuzu tomu uverit. {Color:Green}Hrad Hyrule{Color:White}
je zaplaven monstry...

en:
The monsters will be coming for us
next! We'd better stay inside!
cz:
Monstra prijdou pro nas jako dalsi!
Radsi zustanme uvnitr!

en:
{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White} has become nothing more
than a giant nest for monsters!
Those of us who are left must protect
the town from those beasts!
cz:
{Color:Green}Hrad Hyrule{Color:White} se stal jen
obrim hnizdem monster!
My, kdo jsme zustali, musime mesto
branit pred temi bestiemi!

en:
There's an old legend that something
big will happen when Hyrule's bell rings.
cz:
Stara legenda rika, ze az se rozezni
Hyrulsky zvon, stane se neco velkeho.

en:
I think the time has come. The time
spoken of in legends.
I'm...moved beyond words...
cz:
Myslim, ze ten cas nadesel. Cas,
o kterem mluvi legendy.
Jsem...dojaty az k slzam...

en:
Tighten the defenses around the town!
Don't let them in, no matter what!
cz:
Posilte obranu mesta!
Nepustte je dovnitr, at se deje co se deje!

en: Rrrrr...ARF ARF!
cz: Vrrrr...HAF HAF!

en: Arf arf!
cz: Haf haf!

en: Awooooo!!!
cz: Auuuuu!!!

en:
That kid over there in the glasses
is such a weirdo...
You could probably tell by looking at
him. He's all right, really.
I mean, it's just hard to hate
a guy like that! Hehehe...
cz:
Ten kluk tamhle v brylich
je takovy podivin...
Urcite to poznas podle pohledu.
Ale je v pohode, vazne.
Proste je tezky takoveho kluka
nemit rad! Hehehe...

en:
My {Color:Red}figurines{Color:White}! They're alive!
They're moving!
Hehehehe...
That's SO cool!!
cz:
Moje {Color:Red}figurky{Color:White}! Jsou zive!
Hybou se!
Hehehehe...
To je TAK super!!

en:
This is definitely not the time to be
looking for that dumb {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}.
cz:
Tohle vazne neni cas na hledani
te hloupe {Color:Red}svetelne sily{Color:White}.

en:
It's so lonely here now... I wonder
if the monsters really are coming.
cz:
Je tu ted tak smutno... Asi sem
ta monstra opravdu prijdou.

I'm a rich guy, see?
And I'm a collector to boot.

A k tomu jeste sberatel.

Way to go, man.
What an awesome day...
cz:

Jaky uzasny den...

en:
Evacuation?! What a pain...

But I don't want to cause any trouble,
so I guess I'll just have to cooperate.
cz:
Evakuace?! To je otrava...

Ale nechci delat problemy,
takze asi budu muset spolupracovat.

en:
Everyone's getting out of here.
Will there even be a Hyrule Town soon?
cz:
Vsichni odsud odchazi.
Bude vubec brzy mesto Hyrule existovat?

en:
Maybe I should go hide in the cucco
lady's house...
It might be dangerous, though. It
seems like there's danger everywhere.
cz:
Mozna bych se mel schovat v dome
pani od cucc...
Mohlo by to byt nebezpecne. Zda se,
ze nebezpeci je vsude.

en:
Hey, you came back?

Not a lot of people are coming
by anymore... Not these days.
I guess that means you really
like me, huh?
cz:
Hele, ty ses vratil?

Uz sem moc lidi nechodi...
V techto dnech ne.
Takze ti se mnou je asi
opravdu fajn, co?

en:
We're under martial law!?
Which Minish house should I go to?
If I end up somewhere alone,
they'll forget all about me!
Oh goodness, oh goodness!
cz:
Jsme ve valecnem stavu!?
Do ktereho Minish domu mam jit?
Kdyz skoncim nekde sam,
zapomenou na me!
Oh proboha, oh proboha!

Thanks for coming.

I'm so glad the boss is back to his

It just makes you grateful

cz:
Jsem rad, ze je sef zase
ve sve kuzi.
Clovek je pak vdecnejsi
za ty dobre casy, vis?

en:
Some people still refuse to take
shelter. I don't know what to tell them!
cz:
Nekteri lidi se porad odmitaji
schovat. Nevim, co jim mam rict!

en:
Now that everyone's gone...
I'm kind of scared.
cz:
Ted, kdyz vsichni odesli...
Mam tak trochu strach.

en:
I saw something... Do you think it was
a ghost? Or maybe...a monster?
I'm not afraid! I'm going to defend
Hyrule, no matter what!
cz:
Neco jsem videl... Myslis, ze to byl
duch? Nebo mozna...monstrum?
Nebojim se! Budu branit
Hyrule, at se deje co se deje!

en:
This used to be such a lively town...
Whatever happened to this place?
cz:
Tohle byvalo tak zive mesto...
Co se s timhle mistem stalo?

en:
Hey, you! It's too dangerous to be
just wandering around! Get inside!
cz:
Hej, ty! Je moc nebezpecne se tu
proste potulovat! Bez dovnitr!

en:
We'll protect you!
You can return home safely!
cz:
Ochranime te!
Muzes se v bezpeci vratit domu!

en:
Maybe those monsters are why the {Color:Green}king{Color:White}
has been acting so strange lately...
cz:
Mozna jsou ta monstra duvod, proc se
{Color:Green}kral{Color:White} v poslednim case chova tak divne...

en: It's too dangerous here! Go home!
cz: Tady je moc nebezpecno! Bez domu!

en:
We're shorin' up the town's defenses,
so we'll be ready if the monsters strike!
cz:
Posilujem obranu mesta,
abysme byli pripraveni, az monstra uderi!

en:
Hey, you can't be out here!
Get back inside now!
cz:
Hej, tady nemuzes byt!
Okamzite zpatky dovnitr!

en:
There aren't even any animals here
anymore... What's happening?
cz:
Uz tu nejsou ani zadna zvirata...
Co se to deje?

en:
Ho ho! Here we are! You've come to the
fabulous {Color:Green}Simon's Simulations{Color:White}!
Would you like to hear about us?{Color:Green}
{Color:White} {Choice:3D:03}No, thanks    {Choice:3D:02}Yes, please
cz:
Ho ho! Tady jsme! Prisels do
uzasnych {Color:Green}Simonovych simulaci{Color:White}!
Chces si o nas poslechnout?{Color:Green}
{Color:White} {Choice:3D:03}Ne, diky    {Choice:3D:02}Ano, prosim

en:
Ho ho! Well certainly!
Now how shall I put this...
"We offer you the chance to be
the hero you dream of becoming!"
We allow you to fight grand monsters
without any danger!
This is our unique service!
Now...
I can't say this too loudly, but...

If you dispatch a monster skillfully
enough, you might get {Color:Blue}something nice{Color:White}.
Now, even though this is only a
simulation...
It is still not for the faint of heart!

If you should die in this simulation,
why then... Well, I don't know!
It's never happened!!

{07:3D:03}
cz:
Ho ho! No samozrejme!
Jak to jen rict...
"Nabizime ti sanci stat se
hrdinou, jakym chces byt!"
Umoznime ti bojovat s velkymi monstry
bez jakehokoliv nebezpeci!
To je nase unikatni sluzba!
A ted...
Nemuzu to rict moc nahlas, ale...

Kdyz monstrum porazis dostatecne
dovedne, mozna dostanes {Color:Blue}neco peknyho{Color:White}.
Ale i kdyz je to jen
simulace...
Neni to pro slabe povahy!

Kdybys v teto simulaci zemrel,
tak... No, nevim!
Nikdy se to nestalo!!

{07:3D:03}

en:
It's {Color:Blue}10 Rupees for one try{Color:White}! Interested?
 {Choice:FF}I'll do it!    {Choice:3D:04}No, thanks!
cz:
Je to {Color:Blue}10 rupii za jeden pokus{Color:White}! Mas zajem?
 {Choice:FF}Jdu do toho!    {Choice:3D:04}Ne, diky!

en:
I see. Well, then how about some
pickles? They're homemade!
cz:
Aha. Tak co treba nejake
okurky? Jsou domaci!

en:
Ho hee ho...
Huh? Hey!! Did I miscount or something?
Nope! You just don't have enough
Rupees!
You mean to tell me you don't even
have {Color:Blue}10 {Color:White}stinkin' {Color:Blue}Rupees{Color:White}?
No way! That's hilarious!
cz:
Ho hi ho...
Co? Hej!! Spocital jsem to spatne?
Ne! Proste nemas dost
rupii!
Chces mi rict, ze nemas ani
{Color:Blue}10 {Color:White}pitomych {Color:Blue}rupii{Color:White}?
To snad ne! To je k smichu!

en:
I see... So you're going then...
Well, lemme get her fired up here...
Now, you're getting veeeery sleeepy...
Sooo veery sleeeepy...
Ho...
Hee...
Ho...

Howza!!
cz:
Aha... Takze jdes do toho...
Dobre, nastartuju to...
Uz jsi velmiii ospalyyy...
Taaak veeelmi ospalyyy...
Ho...
Hi...
Ho...

Hopla!!

en:
How was it? Did you enjoy the ride?

Please come back and try it
again anytime!
We're always open! Selling dreams to
John Q. Public! Yessir!
cz:
Jak to bylo? Uzils si jizdu?

Prijd to zkusit zase
nekdy znovu!
Mame vzdy otevreno! Prodavame sny
verejnosti! Ano, pane!

en: I love my dad!
cz: Mam rad svoeho taty!

en:
The children are on their lunch recess.
Playing is as important as studying!
After all, a healthy body leads to a
healthy mind!
cz:
Deti maji obednovou prestavku.
Hra je stejne dulezita jako studium!
Koneckoncu, zdrave telo vede ke
zdrave mysli!

en:
Hello, {Player}! We haven't seen you in
school in a while! I'm so glad you came!
cz:
Ahoj, {Player}! Uz jsme te ve skole
chvili nevideli! Jsem rada, ze jsi prisel!

en:
I tell you, these kids are almost as
mischievous as you are.{Symbol:0B}
cz:
Rikam ti, ty deti jsou skoro tak
zlobive jako ty.{Symbol:0B}

en:
Mmm... Chomp, chomp. We have to eat
fast so we can have a longer recess!
Chomp, chomp.
cz:
Mmm... Mnam, mnam. Musime jist
rychle, abysme meli delsi prestavku!
Mnam, mnam.

en:
Chomp, chomp. I'm always the last to
finish eating...
Chomp, chomp.
cz:
Mnam, mnam. Vzdycky dojidam
jako posledni...
Mnam, mnam.

en: Recess is almost over...
cz: Prestavka uz skoro skoncila...

en:
Mmmmmnumnumnum...

Zzzzzzzzzzzzz...
cz:
Mmmmmnamnamnam...

Chrrrrrrrrr...

en:
I like reading books.

I get to pretend I'm the hero and run
around having adventures and stuff!
cz:
Mam rad cteni knih.

Muzu predstirat, ze jsem hrdina
a delam dobrodruzstvi a tak!

en: You kids run along now, you hear?
cz: Vy deti uz utikejte, slysite?

en:
I have to see these kids off
and get home myself.
cz:
Musim ty deti vyprovodit
a sama jit domu.

en: I don't want to go home.
cz: Nechci jit domu.

en: I looove school!
cz: Skolu zboooznuju!

en:
Boy, when I was your age I was quite
the little terror!
I was tearing up opponents left and
right at the Picori Festival tourney.
Oh, I was really something back in
the day...
In fact, I still have a lot of the
{Color:Red}Kinstone pieces {Color:White}I won at the tourney.
So I wouldn't say no if you were
interested in fusing Kinstones...
cz:
Kluku, kdyz jsem byl ve tvem veku,
byl jsem mala potvora!
Drtil jsem soupere vlevo i vpravo
na turnaji Festivalu Piccoru.
Oh, kdysi jsem byl opravdu
neco...
Vlastne porad mam spoustu
{Color:Red}Kamenu osudu {Color:White}vyhranych na turnaji.
Takze bych nerekl ne, kdybys mel
zajem o spojovani Kamenu osudu...

en:
That green cap and green clothes...
Are you...perhaps...a fairy?!
Woohaaa!{Symbol:0B} I knew it! I knew it!
{Color:Green}Tingle{Color:White} wants to be a fairy, too!{Symbol:0B}
Actually, {Color:Green}Tingle {Color:White}has some {Color:Red}Kinstones{Color:White},
you know!
And I have given {Color:Red}Kinstones{Color:White} to my
brothers, too.
If you can fuse {Color:Red}Kinstones{Color:White} with me and
each of my brothers, well...
I don't want to give it away, but you'll
get something very, very, VERY good!
Good luck, Mr. Fairy!
cz:
Ta zelena cepice a zelene saty...
Jsi...mozna...vila?!
Jupiii!{Symbol:0B} Vedel jsem to! Vedel jsem to!
{Color:Green}Tingle{Color:White} taky chce byt vila!{Symbol:0B}
Vlastne, {Color:Green}Tingle {Color:White}ma nejake {Color:Red}Kameny osudu{Color:White},
vis!
A dal jsem {Color:Red}Kameny osudu{Color:White} i svym
bratrum.
Kdyz spojis {Color:Red}Kameny osudu{Color:White} se mnou i
se vsemi mymi bratry, no...
Nechci to prozradit, ale dostanes
neco velmi, velmi, VELMI dobreho!
Hodne stesti, pane Vilo!

en:
Have you found all of Tingle's
brothers yet?
If you can fuse {Color:Red}Kinstones{Color:White} with all of
us, Tingle has a surprise for you...
In fact, Tingle is POSITIVE you will get
something very, very, VERY good!
Good luck, Mr. Fairy!
cz:
Nasels uz vsechny Tingleovy
bratry?
Kdyz s nami vsemi spojis {Color:Red}Kameny
osudu{Color:White}, Tingle pro tebe ma prekvapeni...
Tingle je SI JISTY, ze dostanes
neco velmi, velmi, VELMI dobreho!
Hodne stesti, pane Vilo!

en:
Hey! Mr. Fairy! You've got some nice
pieces there!
Would you be surprised to know Tingle
has a new piece, too? Let's fuse them!
cz:
Hej! Pane Vilo! Mas tam nejake
pekne kousky!
Prekvapilo by te, kdybych ti rekl, ze
Tingle ma taky novy kousek? Spojme je!

en:
That's twice we've fused our
Kinstones perfectly so far!
Say... I wonder if this will make me into
a real and true fairy! It will, right?
You wouldn't lie to me, now!
Tingle Tingle Kooloo-Limpa!
I can't wait to be a fairy!{Symbol:0B}
cz:
To je uz podruhe, co jsme dokonale
spojili nase Kameny osudu!
Rekni... Asi me to udela skutecnou
a pravou vilou! Ze jo?
Nelhal bys mi, vid!
Tingle Tingle Kooloo-Limpa!
Nemuzu se dockat, az budu vila!{Symbol:0B}

en:
Oh, Mr. Fairy. Hello.

My brother {Color:Green}Tingle {Color:White}is always telling
us about you.
He says he owes a lot to you fairies,
and I know he'd want me to thank you.
In fact, he gave me some {Color:Red}Kinstone
pieces{Color:White} that you might want to fuse!
What do you say?
Want to try it?
cz:
Oh, pane Vilo. Ahoj.

Muj bratr {Color:Green}Tingle {Color:White}o tobe porad
mluvi.
Rika, ze vam vilam hodne dluzi,
a vim, ze by chtel, abych ti podekoval.
Vlastne mi dal nejake {Color:Red}kousky Kamenu
osudu{Color:White}, ktere bys mohl chtit spojit!
Co ty na to?
Chces to zkusit?

en:
Have you seen {Color:Green}Knuckle{Color:White}?

He's my twin brother, and he's dressed
all in blue. I don't know where he is!
cz:
Videl jsi {Color:Green}Knuckla{Color:White}?

Je to muj dvojce a je oblecenej
cely v modrem. Nevim, kde je!

en:
Have you noticed that some people will
{Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White} whenever you want?
And some people won't fuse with you
even though you have Kinstones?
Well, that just means you have to be
persistent and keep asking them!
cz:
Vsiml sis, ze nekteri lidi {Color:Blue}spoji
Kameny osudu{Color:White} kdykoliv chces?
A nekteri lide se s tebou nespoji,
ikdyz mas Kameny osudu?
No, to jen znamena, ze musis byt
vytrvaly a porad se jich ptat!

en:
Hey, Mr. Fairy! I've been holding on to
this, just like {Color:Green}my brother Tingle {Color:White}asked!
And I have {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}!
Want to try and {Color:Blue}fuse {Color:White}with me?
cz:
Hej, pane Vilo! Schoval jsem si
tohle, jak {Color:Green}muj bratr Tingle {Color:White}chtel!
A mam {Color:Red}kousky Kamenu osudu{Color:White}!
Chces zkusit {Color:Blue}spojit {Color:White}se mnou?

en:
All of us brothers look alike, but the
one in white isn't really our brother.
What I can't figure out is why he tries
to dress up like us, though...
cz:
Vsichni bratri vypadame stejne, ale
ten v bilem opravdu neni nas bratr.
Nechapu, proc se snazi oblekat
jako my...

en:
Are you Mr. Fairy? Oh, yeah. Look at
those clothes. You've got to be him!
I received some {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}
from {Color:Green}Tingle{Color:White}.
He said I should try and {Color:Blue}fuse {Color:White}them
with you, Mr. Fairy!
So what do you think?
Should we try to {Color:Blue}fuse{Color:White}?
cz:
Jsi pan Vila? Oh, jo. Podivej se na
ty saty. Musis to byt ty!
Dostal jsem nejake {Color:Red}kousky Kamenu
osudu{Color:White} od {Color:Green}Tingla{Color:White}.
Rekl, ze bych je mel zkusit {Color:Blue}spojit{Color:White}
s tebou, pane Vilo!
Tak co myslis?
Mame zkusit {Color:Blue}spojeni{Color:White}?

en:
I'm not even related to that {Color:Green}Tingle{Color:White}!
So...why am I helping him so much?
cz:
Ja ani nejsem pribuzny toho {Color:Green}Tingla{Color:White}!
Takze...proc mu tolik pomaham?

en:
I have new {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces {Color:White}from {Color:Green}Tingle{Color:White}.

But to tell you the truth, I'd
rather be out adventuring, like you.
And what's with these crazy clothes
he makes us all wear, anyway?
cz:
Mam nove {Color:Red}kousky Kamenu osudu {Color:White}od {Color:Green}Tingla{Color:White}.

Ale popravde, radsi bych byl venku
na dobrodruzstvi, jako ty.
A co je s temi blaznivymi saty,
ktere nas vsechny nuti nosit?

en:
The real key to finding treasure is
{Color:Blue}looking at your map {Color:White}constantly!
Take a step, check the {Color:Red}map{Color:White}! Take
another step, look at the {Color:Red}map {Color:White}again!
I tell ya... All this talk is making me
want to go on an adventure, too!
cz:
Skutecny klic k nalezeni pokladu je
{Color:Blue}neustale se divat na mapu{Color:White}!
Udelej krok, zkontroluj {Color:Red}mapu{Color:White}! Udelej
dalsi krok, podivej se na {Color:Red}mapu {Color:White}znova!
Rikam ti... Tohle povidani me nuti
chtit jit taky na dobrodruzstvi!

en:
{Sound:01:B7}This is one solid wall... I'm going to
need a few friends to give me a hand.
cz:
{Sound:01:B7}Tohle je jedna pevna stena... Budu
potrebovat par kamosu, aby mi pomohli.

en:
{Sound:01:B8}Hn. This rock's too hard... My hands
are starting to hurt...
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}Hn. Tahle skala je moc tvrda... Ruce
me zacinaji bolet...

en:
{Sound:01:B9}I wonder what's in here. Probably
more delicious rocks, hn?
cz:
{Sound:01:B9}Co tu asi je. Asi vic
lahodnych skal, hn?

en:
{Sound:01:BA}It's nice to have my friends helping.
Even if I slack off, no one complains...
cz:
{Sound:01:BA}Je super, ze mi kamaradi pomahaji.
I kdyz se flakam, nikdo si nestezuje...

en:
{Sound:01:B7}One more push! GORO! This is fun...
I'm kind of sad we're almost done.
cz:
{Sound:01:B7}Jeste jeden zatlacit! GORO! To je zabava...
Je mi trochu smutno, ze jsme skoro hotovi.

en:
{Sound:01:B8}Thank goodness! We're finally through!
That was a long way to dig...
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}Diky bohu! Konecne jsme prosli!
To byl dlouhy kus k vyhrabani...

en:
{Sound:01:B9}Together, there's no rock we
can't dig through!
cz:
{Sound:01:B9}Spolecne neni skala, kterou
bysme nemohli prokopat!

en:
{Sound:01:BA}These rocks are delicious. I just want
to stay here forever!
cz:
{Sound:01:BA}Tyhle skaly jsou lahodne. Chci
tu zustat navzdy!

en:
{Sound:01:B7}It's nice having all my friends here,
but sometimes...I can't tell them apart!
cz:
{Sound:01:B7}Je super mit vsechny kamarady tady,
ale obcas...je od sebe nerozeznam!

en:
{Sound:01:B8}You know... With six Gorons all here at
once, it starts to smell a little...ripe.
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}Vis... Kdyz je tu sest Goronu naraz,
zacina to trochu...smrdet.

en:
{Sound:01:B9}That Goron statue outside the cave is
a little scary...
cz:
{Sound:01:B9}Ta Goron socha pred jeskyni je
trochu strasidelna...

en:
Ah, so you moved that gravestone,
and now you can go outside...
But I would get lonely here by myself,
so could you come see me sometime?
I'll have plenty of {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}
ready, so please, do come back!
cz:
Ah, takze jsi pohnul nahrobkem
a ted muzes ven...
Ale byl bych tu sam smutny,
takze nemohl by ses za mnou nekdy stavit?
Budu mit pripravenych spoustu
{Color:Red}kousku Kamenu osudu{Color:White}, tak se prosim vrat!

en:
Oh, you came back to visit!
I'm so happy!
I know this is a grave, but please,
make yourself feel at home!
cz:
Oh, ty ses vratil na navstevu!
Jsem tak stastny!
Vim, ze je to hrob, ale prosim,
citi se jako doma!

en:
Oh, no, no, no! Why, you still have
{Var:1} Kinstones left to fuse!
Why, you've only just begun!
The road is long, Mr. Fairy!
cz:
Oh, ne, ne, ne! Vzdyt ti porad zbyva
{Var:1} Kamenu osudu ke spojeni!
Vzdyt jsi sotva zacal!
Cesta je dlouha, pane Vilo!

en:
Oh, dear! You have {Var:1} Kinstones
left to go! You're not even trying!
I mean, you haven't seen anything yet!
There are still TONS out there!
cz:
Oh, jejda! Mas {Var:1} Kamenu osudu
jeste pred sebou! Ani se nesnazis!
Vzdyt jsi jeste nic nevidel!
Venku je jich jeste SPOUSTA!

en:
Well! You have {Var:1} Kinstones left to
fuse! {Color:Green}Tingle {Color:White}is impressed!
cz:
No! Mas {Var:1} Kamenu osudu jeste
ke spojeni! {Color:Green}Tingle {Color:White}je ohromen!

en:
Just a wee bit more, Mr. Fairy! That's
right! You only have {Var:1} to go!
Just a wee, tiny bit, and you'll have
fused every last Kinstone there is!
cz:
Jeste malicko, pane Vilo! Tak
je to! Mas jen {Var:1} pred sebou!
Jeste malicky kousek a budes mit
spojeny posledni Kamen osudu!

en:
You fused each and every last
Kinstone! Way to go, Mr. Fairy!
You can claim this Tingle trophy
as your own with pride now!
cz:
Spojils kazdy posledni
Kamen osudu! Skvele, pane Vilo!
Muzes si tuhle Tingleovu trofej
hrde narokovat jako svou!

en:
How many Kinstones do you have left to
fuse? Let's see... {Var:1} Kinstones?
You've only just begun your quest for
happiness, Mr. Fairy!
cz:
Kolik Kamenu osudu ti zbyva ke
spojeni? Mrknem... {Var:1} Kamenu osudu?
Sotva jsi zacal hledat
stesti, pane Vilo!

en:
Tch tch tch! You have {Var:1} Kinstones
left to fuse!? You haven't seen a thing!
There are tons out there still!
cz:
Tch tch tch! Mas {Var:1} Kamenu osudu
ke spojeni!? Jeste jsi nic nevidel!
Venku jich je jeste spousta!

en:
How many Kinstones are left?
Let's see... {Var:1} Kinstones to fuse!
I guess you've seen quite a bit of
happiness! No reason to give up now!
cz:
Kolik Kamenu osudu zbyva?
Mrknem... {Var:1} Kamenu osudu ke spojeni!
Uz jsi videl kus stesti!
Neni duvod to ted vzdat!

en:
Oh, you're doing QUITE well! Quite
well indeed!
In fact, you only have {Var:1} left to
go! Keep fusing those Kinstones!
cz:
Oh, vede se ti DOST dobre! Vazne
opravdu dobre!
Mas pred sebou uz jen {Var:1}!
Dal spojuj ty Kameny osudu!

en:
We knew you could do it! 
You fused all the Kinstones!
Way to go, Mr. Fairy! I can practically
see my brother's smiling face now!
cz:
Vedeli jsme, ze to dokazes! 
Spojils vsechny Kameny osudu!
Skvele, pane Vilo! Skoro
uz vidim usmev sveho bratra!

en:
How many Kinstones are left for you
to fuse? Let's see... {Var:1}!?
What are you doing, wasting your time
here! You've got work to do, Mr. Fairy!
cz:
Kolik Kamenu osudu ti zbyva
ke spojeni? Mrknem... {Var:1}!?
Co tady delas, plytvas casem!
Mas praci, pane Vilo!

en:
How many have you not found yet?
Let's see...{Var:1} left to go!
You haven't seen anything yet!
There are tons out there still!
cz:
Kolik jsi jich jeste nenasel?
Mrknem...{Var:1} pred sebou!
Jeste jsi nic nevidel!
Venku jich je jeste spousta!

en:
How many have you not found yet?
Let's see...{Var:1} left to go!
I guess you've seen quite a few!
But this means you have to press on!
cz:
Kolik jsi jich jeste nenasel?
Mrknem...{Var:1} pred sebou!
Uz jsi videl celkem dost!
Ale to znamena, ze musis pokracovat!

en:
Got many Kinstones left to fuse? Let
me see... Hm. Nope! Only {Var:1} to go!
That's not bad at all! In fact, I think
you might just fuse them all!
cz:
Mas hodne Kamenu osudu ke spojeni?
Ukaz... Hm. Ne! Jen {Var:1}!
To neni vubec spatny! Asi je
budes vsechny moct spojit!

en:
You found them all! Can you feel the
happiness flow through you, Mr. Fairy?
cz:
Nasels vsechny! Citis ten proud
stesti, pane Vilo?

en:
So. Fused a lot of Kinstones already?
Let's see here...
Ooo, no... Man! You've got
{Var:1} Kinstones left?
Goodness, man! Get to it!
Time's a-wastin'!!!
cz:
Tak. Uz jsi spojil hodne Kamenu osudu?
Podivam se...
Ooo, ne... Kamo! Mas
{Var:1} Kamenu osudu jeste?
Proboha, kamo! Pust se do toho!
Cas plyne!!!

en:
Oh, oh, oh... You still have 
{Var:1} Kinstones left to fuse?
Still a ways to go! Sigh... If only
I could search for happiness myself...
cz:
Oh, oh, oh... Porad mas 
{Var:1} Kamenu osudu ke spojeni?
Jeste kus cesty! Vzdech... Kdybych jen
mohl hledat stesti sam...

en:
Wow! You're getting closer! Only
{Var:1} Kinstones left to go!
You've found quite a few. Do you think
you could set a few aside for me?
cz:
Wow! Blizis se! Jen
{Var:1} Kamenu osudu zbyva!
Nasels celkem dost. Myslis, ze
bys nejake daly stranou pro me?

en:
You just HAVE to be close now... How
many Kinstones do you have to fuse?
Only {Var:1} left to go! I'm getting all
sad thinking of the end being so near!
cz:
Musis byt uz hodne blizko... Kolik
Kamenu osudu mas ke spojeni?
Jen {Var:1} pred sebou! Je mi smutno
z pomysleni, ze je konec tak blizko!

en:
You found every last one?! You are the
man, er, I mean fairy, Mr. Fairy!
Oh, I do so want to go on an adventure
with you! I do, I do, I do!
cz:
Nasels uplne kazdy?! Jsi ten
chlap, ehm, vila, pane Vilo!
Oh, tak moc chci jit s tebou
na dobrodruzstvi! Chci, chci, chci!

en:
Mr. Fairy! You did it! How incredible!
You fused every last Kinstone there is!
Tingle would love ever so much to send
you something special now!
cz:
Pane Vilo! Dokazals to! Neuveritelne!
Spojils kazdy posledni Kamen osudu!
Tingle by ti tak rad ted poslal
neco specialniho!

en:
What are you doing here?!

This is a graveyard!
There are ghosts here!
Oh yeah, speaking of which, my
brother lives in {Color:Green}Hyrule Town{Color:White}.
He's a troublesome prankster, but
I often wonder how he's doing...
cz:
Co tady delas?!

Tohle je hrbitov!
Jsou tu duchove!
Oh jo, kdyz uz o tom mluvime, muj
bratr zije v {Color:Green}meste Hyrule{Color:White}.
Je to problematicky srandista, ale
casto premyslim, jak se mu dari...

en:
Holder of the sacred powers, we grant
you the power of wind...
cz:
Drziteli posvatnych sil, daruje me
ti silu vetru...

en:
{Sound:01:E4}What? What happened!?
It blew up?
cz:
{Sound:01:E4}Co? Co se stalo!?
Vybuchlo to?

en:
{Sound:00:D4}That was too close, moo! I thought I'd
be ground chuck for sure!
cz:
{Sound:00:D4}To bylo o vlas, bu! Myslela jsem,
ze ze me bude jiste mlety hovezi!

en:
{Sound:00:D4}I'm gonna eat a lot of grass so that
I can make delicious milk! Oh, and moo.
cz:
{Sound:00:D4}Budu jist hodne travy, abych
udelala lahodne mleko! Oh a bu.

en:
{Sound:00:D4}I'm so full!

Mmm! Moo! But it's so delicious!
I just can't stop eating. Moo...
cz:
{Sound:00:D4}Jsem tak plna!

Mmm! Bu! Ale je to tak lahodne!
Proste nemuzu prestat jist. Bu...

en:
{Sound:00:D4}You know that puddle of water in the
middle of the pasture?
There's something kind of suspicious
about it. Moo! Call it a cow's intuition.
cz:
{Sound:00:D4}Znas tu kalouz vody
uprostred pastvy?
Neco je na ni tak trochu
podezreleho. Bu! Nazvi to kravskou intuici.

en:
{Sound:00:D4}Nothing makes me happier than just
standing around, eating grass all day.
cz:
{Sound:00:D4}Nic me nedela stastnejsi nez
stat tu a jist travu cely den.

en:
{Sound:01:B9}I've sold all my {Color:Red}pieces{Color:White}!

Yeah! I KNEW coming to {Color:Green}Hyrule {Color:White}was a
good idea!
cz:
{Sound:01:B9}Prodal jsem vsechny sve {Color:Red}kousky{Color:White}!

Jo! VEDEL jsem, ze jit do {Color:Green}Hyrule {Color:White}byl
dobry napad!

en:
{Sound:01:E4}Hey! There's a symbol up there, but
you're too short for me to see it!{01:0A}
Well, no problem.
I'll remember the spot...
cz:
{Sound:01:E4}Hej! Tam nahore je symbol, ale
jsi moc maly, abys ho videl!{01:0A}
Nic se nedeje.
Zapamatuju si misto...

en:
{Sound:00:90}No matter how many times I see that
happen, it still rattles me...
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Nezalezi na tom, kolikrat to vidim,
porad me to dostane...

en:
{Sound:00:D3}Please! Buy some {Color:Red}Lon Lon Milk{Color:White} from me!

If you don't, my wagon will be too
heavy on the trip home!
cz:
{Sound:00:D3}Prosim! Kup si ode me {Color:Red}Lon Lon Mleko{Color:White}!

Kdyz to neudelas, muj vuz bude
moc tezky na cestu domu!

en:
STAMP! STAMP!
Right to left...
cz:
RAZ! RAZ!
Zprava doleva...

en:
STAMP! STAMP!
It never ends...
cz:
RAZ! RAZ!
Nikdy to neskonci...

en:
STAMP! STAMP!
Even if we hire more people...
cz:
RAZ! RAZ!
I kdyz najmeme vic lidi...

en:
STAMP! STAMP!
It just doesn't matter...
cz:
RAZ! RAZ!
Proste je to jedno...

en:
Welcome!

I'm selling issues of a helpful
adventurer's guide...
It's called the {Color:Red}Swordsman Newsletter{Color:White}.
It's full of useful advice.
Right now, you can buy the latest issue
for only 200 Rupees! It's a bargain!
Would you like to buy an issue?
{Choice:FF}Yes {Choice:40:06}No
cz:
Vitej!

Prodavam vydani uzitecne
pruvodcovsky pro dobrodruhy...
Jmenuje se {Color:Red}Sermirsky bulletin{Color:White}.
Je plny uzitecnych rad.
Prave ted muzes koupit nejnovejsi vydani
za pouhych 200 rupii! To je vyhodne!
Chces si koupit vydani?
{Choice:FF}Ano {Choice:40:06}Ne

en:
Very good! I'll just collect
your 200 Rupees...
cz:
Vyborne! Hned si vezmu
tvych 200 rupii...

en:
I'm sorry. You don't have enough money
to buy an issue.
cz:
Promin. Nemas dost penez
na koupi vydani.

en: Hello! We've got a new issue for you!{Symbol:0B}
cz: Ahoj! Mame pro tebe nove vydani!{Symbol:0B}

en:
I'm sorry, your new issue of the
{Color:Red}Swordsman Newsletter {Color:White}is not in yet...
Swiftblade said he would turn in a new
issue to the publisher soon.
He's just waiting until he can pass
another technique on to a student...
So you can wait, right?
cz:
Promin, tve nove vydani
{Color:Red}Sermirskeho bulletinu {Color:White}jeste neni...
Swiftblade rikal, ze brzy odevzda
nove vydani vydavateli.
Jen ceka, az bude moct predat
dalsi techniku studentovi...
Takze muzes pockat, vid?

en:
You now have the full collection of
the {Color:Red}Swordsman Newsletter{Color:White}!!
Well, I guess you must know all KINDS
of stuff now, huh, "Professor"?{Symbol:0B}
cz:
Mas ted kompletni sbirku
{Color:Red}Sermirskeho bulletinu{Color:White}!!
Urcite uz vis VSELIJAKY
veci, co, "Profesore"?{Symbol:0B}

en:
I am the {Color:Green}postman{Color:White}, crossing town at
incredible speed to bring you your mail!
cz:
Jsem {Color:Green}postak{Color:White}, prebehnu mesto
neuveritelnou rychlosti a prinesu ti postu!

en:
Faster than fast delivery! Swift and
certain, that is the {Color:Green}postman{Color:White}'s aim!
cz:
Rychlejsi nez rychle doruceni! Hbity a
jisty, to je cil {Color:Green}postaka{Color:White}!

en:
Lightly, lightly, lightly...
Lightly treads the carefree {Color:Green}postman{Color:White}!!
cz:
Lehce, lehce, lehce...
Lehce kraci bezstarostny {Color:Green}postak{Color:White}!!

en:
Dash, jump, delivery!!
The {Color:Green}postman {Color:White}cometh!
cz:
Spurt, skok, doruceni!!
{Color:Green}Postak {Color:White}prichazi!

en:
Here before you know it, it's your
amazing neighborhood {Color:Green}postman{Color:White}!
cz:
Tady drive nez si stacis vsimnout,
tvuj uzasny okrskovy {Color:Green}postak{Color:White}!

en:
Known all through Hyrule for his charm
and service, it's your friendly {Color:Green}postman{Color:White}!
cz:
Znamy v celem Hyrule pro sve kouzlo
a sluzby, tvuj pratelsky {Color:Green}postak{Color:White}!

en:
Able to withstand the greatest
of delivery challenges!
I am the {Color:Green}postman {Color:White}of tomorrow,
here today!
cz:
Schopen odolat nejvetsim
dorucovacim vyzvam!
Jsem {Color:Green}postak {Color:White}zitrka,
tady dnes!

en:
Listen up, you! I'm a skilled carpenter,
and I'm looking for a challenge!
cz:
Poslouchej, ty! Jsem zkuseny tesar
a hledam vyzvu!

en:
My ancestors built that castle, you
know! Of course they did!
After all, they are MY ancestors,
aren't they?
cz:
Moji predci postavili ten hrad,
vis! Samozrejme to byli oni!
Koneckoncu, jsou to MOJI predci,
ne?

en:
Do you know of any refined work full of
vim and vigor that might suit my taste?
You know, something with a bit of punch
to it! That's what I'm after!
cz:
Znas nejakou rafinovanou praci plnou
elanu a verve, ktera by se mi hodila?
Vis, neco s trochou sumu!
To je to, co hledam!

en:
Do you know of any challenging work?
Anything with pep? A real test of skill?
You know, any work that's got a bit of
punch to it! That's what I'm after!
cz:
Znas nejakou narocnou praci?
Neco s sumem? Skutecnou zkousku?
Vis, jakoukoliv praci, ktera ma
trochu sumu! To je to, co hledam!

en:
Guffaw! Well, that was a blast! And I
guess it did have some punch to it!
And I'll wager I'm the only person who
could have gotten it done that quickly!
cz:
Hahaha! No, to byla zabava! A asi
v tom byl ten spravny sum!
A vsadim se, ze jsem jediny clovek,
ktery to dokazal udelat tak rychle!

en:
What's that? I should stay indoors just
because there are monsters about?
Don't be silly! I'll go wherever there
is work for me...work with punch!
For I am PUNCH MUTOH!
cz:
Co? Mam zustat doma jen
proto, ze jsou venku monstra?
Nebud hloupy! Pujdu, kamkoliv je
pro me prace...prace s sumem!
Nebo ja jsem RAZNY MUTOH!

en:
Oh, no... A customer...

Why did I ever start a treasure
game shop, anyway? All right then...
Ahem... Welcome to a fascinating 
world of treasure, blah-blah-blah.
In this wonderland, you can test your
luck and win big bucks...maybe.
I don't really recommend it myself,
but whatever. It's your wallet.
cz:
Oh, ne... Zakaznik...

Proc jsem vlastne zacal pokladovou
hru? Dobre tedy...
Ehm... Vitej v fascinujicim 
svete pokladu, bla-bla-bla.
V teto zemi divu muzes vyzkouset
stesti a vyhrat balik...mozna.
Sam to opravdu nedoporucuju,
ale at uz. Je to tvoje penezenka.

en:
It's 10 Rupees for one try, if you still
want to throw your money away on such
a terrible pastime... I would really just
save it if I were you...
  {Choice:FF}Give it a try {Choice:42:05}Quit
cz:
Je to 10 rupii za jeden pokus, pokud
porad chces vyhazovat penize za takovou
hroznou kratochvili... Vazne bych je
radsi setril, kdybych byl tebou...
  {Choice:FF}Zkusit {Choice:42:05}Konec

en:
Oh, good, good! It really is your lucky
day! You don't have enough Rupees!
I'm telling you, this gambling nonsense
is no good. You're better off without!
cz:
Oh, dobre, dobre! Vazne mas stastny
den! Nemas dost rupii!
Rikam ti, tahle hazardni hra je
k nicemu. Je ti lip bez ni!

en:
Right. Right. That's great.

Gambling's no good, kid.
You made the right choice.
cz:
Spravne. Spravne. To je super.

Hazardni hra je spatna, kluku.
Udelals spravnou volbu.

en:
Ahh... Well, the prize is now up
to {Var:1} Rupees.
If you keep playing, your wallet will
explode! Maybe it's best to stop now.
After all, you never know when your
luck will run out and leave you broke.
But...you probably want to keep
going, don't you?!
  {Choice:FF}Yes, let's  {Choice:FF}No, thanks
cz:
Ahh... No, vyhra je ted az
{Var:1} rupii.
Kdyz budes hrat dal, tvoje penezenka
exploduje! Mozna je nejlepsi prestat ted.
Koneckoncu, nikdy nevis, kdy ti stesti
dojde a necha te bez halire.
Ale...asi chces pokracovat,
vid?!
  {Choice:FF}Ano, jdem  {Choice:FF}Ne, diky

en:
Level 1 is more than enough to take 
your money, but if you're feeling
particularly self-destructive, we've
even got level 2 now, rue the day...
Which level would you like to try?
  {Choice:FF}Level 1: Easy   {Choice:FF}Level 2: Hard
cz:
Uroven 1 staci vic nez dost,
aby ti vzala penize, ale jestli se
citi zvlast sebedestruktivne, mame
ted i uroven 2, pohrome dne...
Kterou uroven chces zkusit?
  {Choice:FF}Uroven 1: Lehka   {Choice:FF}Uroven 2: Tezka

en:
I see...
Well, I guess I can't talk you out of it.
All right, I'll get it set up.
Just go in back after I do.
cz:
Aha...
Asi te z toho nemuzu odradit.
Dobre, pripravim to.
Jen jdi dozadu, az to udelam.

en:
Just open whichever chest you like.

If you win, then I'll double the amount
of your bet.
cz:
Otevri jakoukoliv truhlu chces.

Kdyz vyhrajes, zdvojnasobim
vysi tve sazky.

en:
Just open whichever chest you like.

If you win, then I'll triple the amount
of your bet.
cz:
Otevri jakoukoliv truhlu chces.

Kdyz vyhrajes, ztrojnasobim
vysi tve sazky.

en:
You've already paid the man. You might
as well play his game.
cz:
Uz jsi muze zaplatil. Klidne
si tu jeho hru zahraj.

en:
Congratulations.
Your prize is {Var:1} Rupees.
I wouldn't recommend it, but...you can
wager your winnings and try again.
Think about it. You already got a prize
and everything. Don't push your luck.
  {Choice:42:19}Let's do it!   {Choice:42:1A}No, thanks
cz:
Gratuluju.
Tvoje vyhra je {Var:1} rupii.
Nedoporucuju to, ale...muzes
vsadit vyhru a zkusit znovu.
Premysli o tom. Uz jsi dostal vyhru
a vse. Nepokousej stesti.
  {Choice:42:19}Jdem do toho!   {Choice:42:1A}Ne, diky

en:
Ah... I see...

Well, when you're ready,
just open another chest.
cz:
Ah... Aha...

Az budes pripraven,
jen otevri dalsi truhlu.

en:
Right! I'm so glad you've finally come
back to reality!
Just go wait in the front room. I'll
be right out with your prize.
cz:
Spravne! Jsem rad, ze ses konecne
vratil do reality!
Jen pockej v predni mistnosti.
Budu hned venku s tvou vyhrou.

en:
Ahh, I just can't take this!
Please, just stop now while you can!
Your prize is 999 Rupees.
Just take it, and never gamble again!
cz:
Ahh, tohle proste nezvladnu!
Prosim, prestan ted, dokud muzes!
Tvoje vyhra je 999 rupii.
Vezmi ji a uz nikdy nehraj!

en:
Now, see! See what happens when you
gamble! Oh, I tried to warn you!
So... You're really done, right?
cz:
Tak vidis! Vidis, co se stane, kdyz
hazardujes! Oh, snazil jsem se te varovat!
Takze... Uz jsi vazne hotovy, vid?

en:
Which level would you like to try?
  {Choice:FF}Level 1: Easy   {Choice:FF}Level 2: Hard
cz:
Kterou uroven chces zkusit?
  {Choice:FF}Uroven 1: Lehka   {Choice:FF}Uroven 2: Tezka

en:
Now, when you're ready,
just choose a chest.
cz:
Ted, az budes pripraven,
jen si vyber truhlu.

en:
Congratulations.
Here's your prize of {Var:1} Rupees.
But I just want to warn you, the wheel
of fortune is ever turning.
You may think you've found easy money,
but life's not always like that.
What I'm saying here is...stay away,
kid. Gambling's no good.
cz:
Gratuluju.
Tady je tva vyhra {Var:1} rupii.
Ale chci te varovat, kolo
stesti se vecne otaci.
Myslis si, ze jsi nasel snadne penize,
ale zivot tak vzdy neni.
To, co tady rikam, je...drz se dal,
kluku. Hazardni hra je spatna.

en:
Sorry, no prize this time.

That's right. Gambling's not what you
thought it was, is it?
And don't think "Maybe I'll win next
time," either. 
Wake up, man! Get out of here before
you lose the shirt off your back!
cz:
Promin, tentokrat zadna vyhra.

Spravne. Hazardni hra neni to,
co sis myslel, vid?
A ani si nemysli "Mozna vyhraju
prestou,". 
Prober se, kamo! Vypadni odsud,
nez prijdes o kosili na zadech!

en:
Ahh... He's finally opened up!
I can't wait to get crackin'!
cz:
Ahh... Konecne otevrel!
Nemuzu se dockat, az do toho zacnu!

en:
How's it goin'?
You winnin' much, pal?
cz:
Jak to jde?
Vyhravas hodne, kamo?

en:
Don't get hooked on gambling.
You always lose in the end...
But people keep playing!
cz:
Nezavisni na hazardni hre.
Nakonec vzdy prohrajes...
Ale lide porad hraji!

en:
I guess this is no time for games,
really, is it?
cz:
Asi ted neni cas na hry,
opravdu, vid?

en: {Choice:43:17}Trade {Choice:43:08}Don't trade
cz: {Choice:43:17}Smenit {Choice:43:08}Nesmenit

en:
I collect those {Color:Red}Mysterious Shells{Color:White} you've
seen scattered all over the place.
If you bring those shells to me, I'll
trade you these {Color:Red}figurines {Color:White}I have made.
cz:
Sbiram ty {Color:Red}Tajemne Ulity{Color:White}, ktere jsi
videl rozesete vsude kolem.
Kdyz mi ty ulity prinesese, vymenim ti
je za tyhle {Color:Red}figurky {Color:White}, ktere jsem udelal.

en:
Ahh, is that a {Color:Red}Mysterious Shell{Color:White}? Hm...
I've got an offer I'd like to make you.
What do you say to trading it for
{Color:Blue}a chance at winning a figurine{Color:White}?
{07:43:02}
cz:
Ahh, je tohle {Color:Red}Tajemna Ulita{Color:White}? Hm...
Mam pro tebe nabidku.
Co na to, abys ji vymenil za
{Color:Blue}sanci vyhrat figurku{Color:White}?
{07:43:02}

en:
Oh, you don't have any {Color:Red}Mysterious
Shells{Color:White} on you?
Well, please come see me when you do.
cz:
Oh, nemas u sebe zadne {Color:Red}Tajemne
Ulity{Color:White}?
Tak se za mnou stav, az budes mit.

en:
Too bad. Come back if you ever
change your mind, though.
cz:
Skoda. Vrat se, kdyby sis to
nekdy rozmyslel.

en:
Oh, you're back. Well, you must have
liked that last {Color:Red}figurine{Color:White}.
Do you want to try for another one?
{07:43:02}
cz:
Oh, ty ses vratil. Musela se ti
libit ta posledni {Color:Red}figurka{Color:White}.
Chces zkusit dalsi?
{07:43:02}

en:
Want to try another drawing?
{07:43:02}
cz:
Chces zkusit dalsi losovani?
{07:43:02}

en:
Oh, hello again. I was hoping
you'd come back.
I {Color:Blue}made a new figurine{Color:White}, and I thought
you might like to try to get it.
{07:43:02}
cz:
Oh, zase ahoj. Doufal jsem,
ze se vratis.
{Color:Blue}Vytvoril jsem novou figurku{Color:White} a myslel,
ze bys ji mohl chtit ziskat.
{07:43:02}

en:
It looks like you already have {Color:Blue}every
figurine I make{Color:White}.
Do you still want to have a try?
{07:43:02}
cz:
Vypada to, ze uz mas {Color:Blue}kazdou
figurku, kterou delam{Color:White}.
Chces si presto vyzkouset?
{07:43:02}

en:
Ahh, thanks for coming.

You seem to {Color:Blue}have won all the figurines
I've made so far{Color:White}.
Would you like to draw for one anyway?
{07:43:02}
cz:
Ahh, diky, ze jsi prisel.

Zda se, ze jsi {Color:Blue}vyhral vsechny figurky,
ktere jsem zatim udelal{Color:White}.
Chces si presto vylosovat?
{07:43:02}

en:
Hey, I've been waiting for you!
I've got something new to show you.
It's our {Color:Blue}final series{Color:White}, my friend.
Check it out!
Do you want to try to draw one now?
{07:43:02}
cz:
Hej, cekal jsem na tebe!
Mam ti neco noveho ukazat.
Je to nase {Color:Blue}finalni serie{Color:White}, kamo.
Mrkni!
Chces si ted vylosovat?
{07:43:02}

en:
How many {Color:Red}shells{Color:White} would you like to use
in this drawing?
The more shells you use, the more likely
you are to win a figure you don't have.
cz:
Kolik {Color:Red}ulit{Color:White} chces pouzit
v tomto losovani?
Cim vic ulit pouzijes, tim pravdepodobneji
vyhrajes figurku, kterou jeste nemas.

en:
Probability
Shells: {04:15}{Var:1}{04:14}  {04:15}{Var:2}{04:14}{Symbol:12}

en:
How many {Color:Red}shells{Color:White} do you want to trade
on this drawing?
cz:
Kolik {Color:Red}ulit{Color:White} chces smenit
na toto losovani?

en: You're going to trade {Var:1} of them?
cz: Smenis jich {Var:1}?

en: {Choice:43:1E}Yes {Choice:43:17}No
cz: {Choice:43:1E}Ano {Choice:43:17}Ne

en:
Great. Now, just pull the {Color:Blue}lever{Color:White} on the
{Color:Blue}figure-dispensing machine{Color:White} over there.
cz:
Skvele. Ted jen zatahni za {Color:Blue}paku{Color:White} na
{Color:Blue}stroji na vydavani figurek{Color:White} tamhle.

en:
Oh, hold on! You've already traded your
{Color:Red}shells{Color:White} away...
If you leave without trying, you've
just wasted your shells!
cz:
Oh, pockej! Uz jsi smenil sve
{Color:Red}ulity{Color:White}...
Kdyz odejdes bez zkousky, jen
jsi promrhal sve ulity!

en:
Oh! Looks like you've already got that
{Color:Red}figurine{Color:White}. Too bad, isn't it?
Well, I'll buy that {Color:Red}figurine {Color:White}back from
you for {Var:1} Rupees if you like.
cz:
Oh! Vypada to, ze uz tu {Color:Red}figurku{Color:White} mas.
Skoda, vid?
Koupim ti tu {Color:Red}figurku {Color:White}zpet
za {Var:1} rupii, jestli chces.

en:
Congratulations!

I'll keep the figurine in the case on the
left for you. You can see it anytime.
cz:
Gratuluju!

Nechame figurku ve vitrine vlevo
pro tebe. Muzes si ji prohlednout kdykoliv.

en:
I hope you keep collecting and decide
to come back again!
cz:
Doufam, ze budes dal sbirat
a rozhodnes se zase vratit!

en:
Wow!

My friend, you've just gotten the
last figurine in the machine.
But I'll make some more,
so please come back again.
cz:
Wow!

Kamo, prave jsi ziskal
posledni figurku ve stroji.
Ale udelam jich vic,
tak se prosim zase vrat.

en:
Congratulations!

You've now collected {Color:Blue}all of the
figurines that I've made{Color:White}!
I'll keep a good eye on all of your
figures in the case...
Please, come see them anytime!
cz:
Gratuluju!

Nasbiral jsi ted {Color:Blue}vsechny
figurky, ktere jsem udelal{Color:White}!
Budu hlidat vsechny tve
figurky ve vitrine...
Prijd se na ne podivat kdykoliv!

en:
No way! Congratulations!

You've {Color:Blue}collected every single figure
I've ever made{Color:White}!
I'll keep a good eye on your collection
on the shelf here.
And here, I want you to have this!

It's the {Color:Red}Carlov Medal{Color:White}, to commemorate
your copious collection!
I hope you treasure it always!
cz:
To neni mozne! Gratuluju!

{Color:Blue}Nasbiral jsi kazdou figurku,
kterou jsem kdy udelal{Color:White}!
Budu hlidat tvou sbirku
na police tady.
A tady, chci, abys mel tohle!

Je to {Color:Red}Carlovova medaile{Color:White}, na pamatku
tve bohate sbirky!
Doufam, ze si ji vzdy budes vazit!

en:
Are you curious about that machine?
I can explain it if you like.
cz:
Zajima te ten stroj?
Muzu ti to vysvetlit, jestli chces.

en:
That's a case for displaying figurines.
No one's using it right now, though.
cz:
To je vitrina pro vystavu figurek.
Nikdo ji ted ale nepouziva.

en:
How do you like that {Color:Red}Carlov Medal{Color:White}?
Pretty impressive, isn't it?
It's proof of your super collecting
abilities! Wear it with pride, my friend!
cz:
Jak se ti libi ta {Color:Red}Carlovova medaile{Color:White}?
Dost impozantni, vid?
Je to dukaz tvych super sberatelskych
schopnosti! Nos ji hrde, kamo!

en:
{Sound:00:CC} Whuzza?! Oh, welcome!
Welcome to {Color:Green}Rem's Shoe Shop{Color:White}!
Lately, whenever I take a nap, all my
shoes are done when I wake up!
{07:44:02}
cz:
{Sound:00:CC} Cosi?! Oh, vitej!
Vitej v {Color:Green}Remove obchode s botami{Color:White}!
V poslednim case, kdykoliv si zdrimnu,
vsechny boty jsou hotove az se vzbudim!
{07:44:02}

en:
You know, if I can make shoes in my
sleep, I must be in the right job!
cz:
Vis, kdyz dokazu delat boty
ve spanku, musim byt ve spravne praci!

en: Mmmmmnumnumnumnum...
cz: Mmmmmnamnamnamnam...

en:
Whaa--!

What is that terrifyingly bad smell!?
A wake-up mushroom?!
I should have guessed!
So you woke me up?
Thanks, I just remembered I have
something urgent to do!
cz:
Coo--!

Co je to za desive smrdute aroma!?
Probouzeci houba?!
Mel jsem to tusit!
Takzes me vzbudil?
Diky, zrovna jsem si vzpomnel, ze
mam neco neodkladneho na praci!

en:
And there we go...
Here, take these.
Those are my special {Color:Red}Pegasus Boots{Color:White}!

They're so light, you'll feel like you're
practically walking on air!
cz:
A je to...
Tady, vezmi si tyhle.
To jsou moje specialni {Color:Red}Pegasove boty{Color:White}!

Jsou tak lehke, budes mit pocit,
ze prakticky chodis po vzduchu!

en:
Ooh, I need to hurry up and get
working on that special order...
The king asked me to make some
shoes for Princess Zelda, you see.
Thanks for waking me up. Come back if
I can ever help you with shoe problems.
cz:
Ooh, musim si pospisit a zacit
pracovat na te specialni objednavce...
Kral me poprosil, abych udelal nejake
boty pro princeznu Zeldu, vis.
Diky, ze jsi me vzbudil. Vrat se, kdykoliv
bys potreboval pomoct s botami.

en:
I need to hurry up and make those
shoes for Princess Zelda!
cz:
Musim si pospisit a udelat ty
boty pro princeznu Zeldu!

en:
Whuzza?! Oh, welcome!
Welcome to {Color:Green}Rem's Shoe Shop{Color:White}!
I must have dozed off again...
Time to make the shoes!
cz:
Cosi?! Oh, vitej!
Vitej v {Color:Green}Remove obchode s botami{Color:White}!
Asi jsem zase usnul...
Cas delat boty!

en:
Thank you for waking me up earlier.

Oh, say, you wouldn't want to {Color:Blue}fuse
Kinstones{Color:Red} {Color:White}with me, would you?
I have a very special {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White}!
cz:
Diky, ze jsi me predtim vzbudil.

Oh, rekni, nechtel bys {Color:Blue}spojit
Kameny osudu{Color:Red} {Color:White}se mnou?
Mam velmi specialni {Color:Red}kousek Kamene osudu{Color:White}!

en:
Come see me again sometime! If I'm
awake, I'll fuse {Color:Blue}Kinstones{Color:White} with you!
cz:
Stav se za mnou zase nekdy! Kdyz
budu vzhuru, spojim {Color:Blue}Kameny osudu{Color:White} s tebou!

en:
I know! Do you want to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}
with me? I have a very special one!
cz:
Vim! Chces {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}
se mnou? Mam jeden velmi specialni!

en:
I'm really blazing away on these shoes
for Princess Zelda!
cz:
Vazne sviham s temi botami
pro princeznu Zeldu!

en:
?!
Huh? What now?!
There are more new shoes!
You probably won't believe this, but...
I have a strange habit of making
shoes in my sleep!
So you must have come here because
you want some of my shoes, right?
Tell you what: because you were nice
enough to wake me, you can have 'em!
Hold on a sec, though. I just want
to finish this one last bit...
cz:
?!
Co? Co ted?!
Jsou tu dalsi nove boty!
Mozna tomu neuveris, ale...
Mam podivny zvyk delat
boty ve spanku!
Takze jsi sem urcite prisel, protoze
chces nejake moje boty, vid?
Vis co: protoze jsi byl tak hodny
a vzbudil me, muzes je dostat!
Momentik, jen chci
dokoncit tenhle posledni kousek...

en:
{Sound:02:04}Those {Color:Red}Pegasus Boots {Color:White}will make you
want to dash everywhere!
It's really fun to run headlong into
stuff and really shake things up!
cz:
{Sound:02:04}Ty {Color:Red}Pegasove boty {Color:White}te budou nutit
spurtit vsude!
Je to opravdu zabava utikat strmhlav
do veci a poradne to rozhybat!

en:
{Sound:01:FC}My {Color:Red}Pegasus Boots {Color:White}are so comfortable!

They'll make your little piggies
squeal with delight!
cz:
{Sound:01:FC}Moje {Color:Red}Pegasove boty {Color:White}jsou tak pohodlne!

Tve nozicky budou
kvicet radosti!

en:
{Sound:01:F8}Thanks for wearing my shoes with such
pride, valued customer!
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Diky, ze nosis moje boty s takovou
hrdosti, vazeny zakazniku!

en:
{Sound:02:04}Hey, hey! You're {Player}, right?

You're the one who brought the sword
to {Color:Green}Master Melari{Color:White}!
You're on a quest to help the princess,
aren't you?
I wish I could go on a quest, but
then who'd make {Color:Green}Rem{Color:White}'s shoes for him?
cz:
{Sound:02:04}Hej, hej! Ty jsi {Player}, vid?

Ty jsi ten, kdo prinesl mec
{Color:Green}Mistru Melarimu{Color:White}!
Jsi na vyprave pomoct princezne,
vid?
Rad bych sel taky na vypravu, ale
kdo by pak delal boty pro {Color:Green}Rema{Color:White}?

en:
{Sound:01:FC}Ho, ho! You need {Color:Red}Pegasus Boots{Color:White}?
Why, you're just in time!
We made a pair just now while
{Color:Green}Rem {Color:White}was sleeping.
But only {Color:Green}Rem {Color:White}can put the
finishing touches on them...
cz:
{Sound:01:FC}Ho, ho! Potrebujes {Color:Red}Pegasove boty{Color:White}?
No, prichazis prave vcas!
Udelali jsme par zrovna ted, zatimco
{Color:Green}Rem {Color:White}spal.
Ale jen {Color:Green}Rem {Color:White}muze udelat
posledni upravy...

en:
{Sound:01:F8}Ha, ha! That sleepyhead {Color:Green}Rem {Color:White}is nearly
impossible to wake up...
If you want to wake him, you'll need
to get an item from {Color:Green}Syrup{Color:White}'s hut.
It's a little bit of a trek, but
we'll mark it on your map for you.
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Ha, ha! Toho spinkala {Color:Green}Rema {Color:White}je skoro
nemozne vzbudit...
Kdyz ho chces vzbudit, budes
potrebovat predmet z {Color:Green}Syrupy{Color:White} chyse.
Je to mala prochazka, ale
vyznacime ti to na mape.

en:
{Sound:02:04}Hey, hey! {Color:Green}Rem {Color:White}has some other urgent
business he should be working on...
So please, wake him up as soon as
you can! Time's a-wastin'!
cz:
{Sound:02:04}Hej, hej! {Color:Green}Rem {Color:White}ma jine neodkladne
zalezitosti, na kterych by mel pracovat...
Tak prosim, vzbud ho co
nejdrive! Cas plyne!

en:
{Sound:01:FA}Ho, ho! We've done all we can with
these shoes.
You'll need to go to {Color:Green}Syrup{Color:White}'s hut so
Rem can put on the finishing touches.
cz:
{Sound:01:FA}Ho, ho! Udelali jsme s temi botami
co jsme mohli.
Musis jit k {Color:Green}Syrupy{Color:White} chyse, aby
Rem mohl pridat posledni upravy.

en:
{Sound:01:F8}Ha, ha! {Color:Green}Syrup{Color:White}'s hut is north of the
{Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White}. Just check your {Color:Red}map{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Ha, ha! {Color:Green}Syrupy{Color:White} chyse je severne od
{Color:Green}Minish lesu{Color:White}. Jen zkontroluj svou {Color:Red}mapu{Color:White}.

en:
I'll make you shoes! So why don't you
come back later?
cz:
Udelam ti boty! Tak proc se
nezastavis pozdeji?

en:
The magic hag may have something
good.
cz:
Magicka baba muze mit neco
dobreho.

en: Sometimes we help him make shoes.
cz: Obcas mu pomahame delat boty.

en:
Hi there, and welcome to the
Happy Hearth! Need a rest, kid?
Well, we can take care of that--and
even throw in a {Color:Red}present {Color:White}to boot!
{07:45:02}
cz:
Ahoj, vitej v
Stastnem krbu! Potrebujes odpocinek, kluku?
O to se postarame--a jeste k tomu
pridame {Color:Red}darek {Color:White}!
{07:45:02}

en:
{Choice:FF}Forget it      {Choice:FF}{Var:1} Rupee room
{Choice:FF}{Var:2} Rupee room {Choice:FF}{Var:3} Rupee room
cz:
{Choice:FF}Zapomen na to  {Choice:FF}Pokoj {Var:1} rupii
{Choice:FF}Pokoj {Var:2} rupii {Choice:FF}Pokoj {Var:3} rupii

en: All payment up front, please!
cz: Platba predem, prosim!

en:
What's this?!
Son, you've got no cash!
Come back when you grow up
and get a job!
Now off with you! Shoo!
cz:
Co to je?!
Synu, nemas zadne penize!
Vrat se, az vyrostes
a sezenes praci!
A ted zmiz! Hys!

en:
Thanks!
Enjoy your stay!
cz:
Diky!
Uzij si pobyt!

en:
Ho, now! You don't want to stay?
Well, come again!
cz:
Ho, ted! Nechces zustat?
No, prijd zase!

en:
That's the exit!
Enjoy your stay!
cz:
To je vychod!
Uzij si pobyt!

en:
And how was your stay?
Did you find your present?
Please come again!
cz:
A jaky byl pobyt?
Nasels svuj darek?
Prijd zase, prosim!

en:
It seems you really get what
you pay for here...
cz:
Zda se, ze tu opravdu dostanes,
co si zaplatis...

en:
But I guess you don't really know the
difference until you try each room...
cz:
Ale rozdil asi opravdu nepoznas,
dokud nezkusis kazdy pokoj...

en:
Hey, what do you know about that
{Color:Red}light force{Color:White} stuff?
People are saying it's some kind of
treasure that can grant you any wish.
Anyway, now the king's in a big huff
trying to find it.
It's strange, though. He never struck
me as the greedy type before.
It's almost like he's a different
person now...
cz:
Hej, co vis o te
{Color:Red}svetelne sile{Color:White}?
Lidi rikaji, ze je to nejaky
poklad, ktery splni jakekoliv prani.
Vsak ted je kral cely zhrouceny,
snazi se to najit.
Je to divne. Nikdy mi nepripadal
jako lakomy typ.
Je to skoro, jako kdyby byl ted
jiny clovek...

en:
What's with the king lately?
He was never like that before...
cz:
Co je s kralem v poslednim case?
Nikdy takovy nebyl...

en: Yaaay! Yaaay!
cz: Jupiii! Jupiii!

en: Waaait!
cz: Pockeej!

en: Hey!!! Wait up!
cz: Hej!!! Pockej!

en:
It's so nice to be here at last!
And such a big town it is!
cz:
Je tak hezke tu konecne byt!
A jake je to velke mesto!

en:
Staying in this inn forever
would start to be a bother...
cz:
Zustat v teto hospode navzdy
by zacalo byt na obtiz...

en:
We need to find a nice, quiet place
where we can settle down.
cz:
Musime najit pekne, klidne misto,
kde se usadime.

en:
The {Color:Green}king {Color:White}is just terrible lately!
Things are going crazy around here!
Would you believe a guard came into my
house the other day?
It's true! And get this! He demanded
that I give him some kind of "{Color:Red}force{Color:White}"!
cz:
{Color:Green}Kral {Color:White}je v poslednim case proste hrozny!
Veci tu sileji!
Uveril bys, ze straz prisla
posledne ke mne domu?
Je to pravda! A poslouchej! Pozadoval,
abych mu dal nejakou "{Color:Red}silu{Color:White}"!

en:
Normal people can't enter the
{Color:Green}Royal Valley{Color:White}.
There's a cryptic forest that leads
into it, and people get lost there.
The secret to finding your way through
is reading all the signs!
You'll never make it unless you read
each one carefully.
cz:
Bezni lide nemohou vstoupit do
{Color:Green}Kralovskeho udoli{Color:White}.
Vede tam tajemny les a
lide se v nem ztraceji.
Tajemstvi, jak se prodrat skrz, je
cist vsechny cedule!
Nikdy to nedokazes, pokud nebudes
kazdou pozorne cist.

en:
You want to go to the tomb of
{Color:Green}King Gustaf of Hyrule{Color:White}?
Then you'd probably better talk
to {Color:Green}Dampé{Color:White}.
He's the gravedigger at the cemetery.
Nobody knows the {Color:Green}Royal Crypt {Color:White}better!
cz:
Chces jit do hrobky
{Color:Green}krale Gustafa z Hyrule{Color:White}?
Tak by ses asi mel
poradit s {Color:Green}Dampem{Color:White}.
Je to hrobnik na hrbitove.
Nikdo nezna {Color:Green}Kralovskou kryptu {Color:White}lepe!

en:
Have you stayed in the best room yet?
I'm trying to figure out where to stay.
cz:
Zustal jsi uz v nejlepsim pokoji?
Snazim se zjistit, kde mam zustat.

en:
The source of water in Hyrule? You
must mean the spring at {Color:Green}Veil Falls{Color:White}.
That's where all our water comes from.
cz:
Zdroj vody v Hyrule? Asi myslis
pramen u {Color:Green}Veil Falls{Color:White}.
Odtud pochazi vsechna nase voda.

en:
I can't say this in front of the kids...
I don't want to alarm them, you know?
But...{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle {Color:White}has been looking
pretty weird lately.
I can't say exactly what it is, though.
It's just...different. Strange.
cz:
Nemuzu to rict pred detmi...
Nechci je vystrasit, vis?
Ale...{Color:Green}hrad Hyrule {Color:White}vypada
v poslednim case dost divne.
Nedokazu rict presne, co to je.
Je to proste...jine. Divne.

en:
I saw it! I saw it with my own two eyes!

There were monsters inside
of {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}!
I've heard rumors that some people who
went to the castle never came back!
cz:
Videl jsem to! Videl jsem to na vlastni oci!

Uvnitr {Color:Green}hradu Hyrule{Color:White}
byla monstra!
Slysel jsem famy, ze nekteri lide,
kteri sli na hrad, se nevratili!

en:
School let out early today!
Lucky!{Symbol:0B}
cz:
Skola dnes skoncila drive!
Klika!{Symbol:0B}

en: Hey! Wait up! Wait for me!
cz: Hej! Pockej! Pockej na me!

en:
I've got no choice.
I guess I'll take shelter here...
I know I can hold my own, but those are
some fierce monsters out there...
cz:
Nemam na vyber.
Asi se tu schovam...
Vim, ze se obhajim, ale tam venku
jsou pekne dive monstra...

en: My mom's a wife, not a wolf.
cz: Moje mama je manzelka, ne vlk.

en: My mom's a wife, not a fife!
cz: Moje mama je manzelka, ne pistalka!

en:
I can't believe she found a place!
I am so jealous.
cz:
Nemuzu uverit, ze nasla misto!
Tak ji zavidim.

en:
Maybe I should go pay her
a visit sometime.
cz:
Mozna bych ji mel jit nekdy
navstivit.

en:
Things just aren't the same around
here now that it's just the two of us.
cz:
Veci uz nejsou stejne,
ted, kdyz jsme tu jen my dva.

en:
I hate being here all alone!

I wish I could find a nice place
to live, like the others did...
cz:
Nesnasim byt tu uplne sam!

Kez bych mohl najit pekne misto
k zivotu, jako ostatni...

en:
It's no fun being here alone. Maybe
I should look for a nice house, too.
cz:
Neni zabava byt tu sam. Mozna
bych si mel taky hledat pekny dum.

en:
Being all alone is...well, lonely. I'm
going to find myself a nice home, too.
cz:
Byt sam je...no, smutne. Najdu si
taky pekny domov.

en:
{Sound:00:D0}I am {Color:Green}Swiftblade{Color:White}, finest swordsman
in all of Hyrule!
If you {Color:Blue}train {Color:White}with me, I guarantee that
you will increase your skill dramatically!
cz:
{Sound:00:D0}Jsem {Color:Green}Swiftblade{Color:White}, nejlepsi sermir
v celem Hyrule!
Kdyz se mnou budes {Color:Blue}trenovat{Color:White}, garantuju,
ze drasticky zvysis svou dovednost!

en:
So? Would you like to {Color:Blue}train {Color:White}here?
  {Choice:FF}Please {Choice:46:5F}No, thanks
cz:
Tak? Chces tu {Color:Blue}trenovat{Color:White}?
  {Choice:FF}Prosim {Choice:46:5F}Ne, diky

en:
Haha! Very good!
You are a very quick student.
But one must FEEL the technique,
not just hear about it!
That's why I will now possess your body
so as to demonstrate the technique!
I call this the {Color:Blue}Swiftblade Possession
technique{Color:White} of training!
Watch this!!
Urrngh!!
Poe...Zeh...SHUN!!!
cz:
Haha! Vyborne!
Jsi velmi rychly student.
Ale clovek musi techniku CITIT,
ne o ni jen slyset!
Proto ted ovladnu tve telo,
abych predvedl techniku!
Nazyvam to {Color:Blue}Swiftbladovo posedlejici
technika{Color:White} treninku!
Sleduj!!
Urrngh!!
Po...se...DLOST!!!

en:
Yes!! Fine work! You're a quick study.
I will now give you this {Color:Red}Tiger Scroll{Color:White}!
If you ever forget this technique,
you can review it with this {Color:Red}scroll{Color:White}!
You may view it anytime from
the Quest Status screen!
cz:
Ano!! Skvela prace! Ucis se rychle.
Dam ti tento {Color:Red}Tygri svitek{Color:White}!
Kdybys nekdy zapomnel tuto techniku,
muzes ji zopakovat s timto {Color:Red}svitkem{Color:White}!
Muzes si ho prohlednout kdykoliv z
obrazovky stavu vypravy!

en:
There are no more techniques I can
teach you {Color:Blue}with your current sword{Color:White}!{Color:Blue}
{Color:White}Come again when you have
{Color:Red}a new sword{Color:White} in hand!
cz:
Uz te nemam co dalsiho
naucit {Color:Blue}s tvym soucasnym mecem{Color:White}!{Color:Blue}
{Color:White}Prijd zase, az budes mit
{Color:Red}novy mec{Color:White} v ruce!

en:
